items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I only had one guitarist with me during the time that I had a band. His name was Hurley Ramey

ctx.x: And he was in Fletcher's band at the Grant Terrace in Chicago. I had a little guitarist named

Bobby Lessee from Brooklyn, New York. Now that was in Fletcher's band. I only had one guitarist with me during the time that I had a band. His name was Hurley Ramey -- a Chicago boy. I haven't seen him for years. that's He was the only guitar player I ever had, and the only reason that I got him was because when I recorded for Okeh, and Columbia, I had to have, you know, four pieces going all the time because I had to stand up sometime and direct, and I made a couple of original tunes -- one called "Ginger Bell,"…
And this is while you were at Swingland?
